analysis.reasonEn: RSI has exited oversold but remains in neutral territory. MACD histogram continues to worsen, indicating selling pressure. Volume ratio at 0.79 suggests subdued activity. Price is consolidating within the 5-day range of $130.75-$157.54, showing a lack of directional conviction.
